root.label: Calder Mountains and Clouds restoration announcement

events.label: Calder Mountains and Clouds restoration announcement

slots.name: restoration cost
slots.sentence: As part of the $12 million restoration effort, the mobile was rebuilt “employing new, cutting-edge advances in engineering and technology,” the Calder Foundation said.

slots.name: mobile span
slots.sentence: while the mobile, which spans 75 feet, is known as the “clouds.”

slots.name: deinstallation year
slots.sentence: The mobile had frozen in place by 1992 before ultimately being deinstalled in 2014.

slots.name: Hart tenure
slots.sentence: “Mountains and Clouds is an American work of art that has been a part of the Hart Building for four decades,” Sen. Amy Klobuchar (D-Minn.) said.

slots.name: announcement date
slots.sentence: The restoration project was announced Thursday by the Calder Foundation.

slots.name: installation date
slots.sentence: made its debut inside the Hart building 10 years later.
